title: De Doelenkade te Hoorn: Cornelis Springer (1875)
author: Deniz
summary: De Doelenkade in Hoorn, bij zomer. Oil on panel, 53.4 x 65.3 cm, signed in full and with monogram at the lower right, and dated 1875. Photo taken 23-04-2026.

title: Het Muiderslot vanuit het noordoosten: Gerrit Berckheyde (1653–1698)
author: Deniz
summary: Het Muiderslot vanuit het noordoosten, painted by Gerrit Berckheyde. Spliced with modern photography of the 13th-century fortress in Muiden.

title: Sisu: The Finnish Spirit of Courage
author: Deniz
summary: An exploration of the Winter War, Simo Häyhä 'The White Death', and the psychological concept of Sisu - extraordinary determination in the face of impossible odds.

title: The Architecture of Mercy: Radical Benevolence in Central Anatolia
author: Deniz
summary: An exploration of Gönül, Central Anatolian troubadour philosophy, and the bittersweet ethics of radical non-retaliation in the steppes of Kırşehir.

title: Pogona: Echoes in the Scales
author: Deniz
summary: An exploration of Seleucus II Callinicus Pogon, Glen Milton Storr's taxonomy of the bearded dragon, and the mysterious black box of animal consciousness.

title: The Meaning-Maker: Redefining the CIO in an Age of Complexity
author: Deniz
summary: From Bletchley Park indexers to modern AI transformation: how technology leaders shift from managing data architecture to collective meaning-making.

title: De geschiedenis van draadloze communicatie in zes generaties
author: Deniz
summary: Van autotelefoons in 0G en de analoge 1G-netwerken tot 5G IoT-pijlers en de futuristische terabit-belofte van 6G.
